reviewContext.userProblem: flying-mail's GraphQL API (graphql-yoga on Hono, Cloudflare Worker mailcal-api plus a Bun server) has only Query and Mutation. Clients poll, and API keys use the fetchStatus pull cursor. There is no low-latency push of mail changes to the web UI or API clients.
requiredOutcomes: Subscription.mailEvents(scope, after) over graphql-transport-ws for session-cookie and API-key principals (Bearer token only in connection_init), with per-event MAIL_READ authorization and scope filtering.

Durable append-only D1 event log (migration 0016_mail_events.sql) with <epoch>.<seq> cursors, 7-day configurable retention with pruning on append; replay-then-live on resubscribe with after=cursor is gap-free and duplicate-free; RESYNC_REQUIRED when the cursor is outside retention or from another epoch.

Writers (ingest, send/sendDraft/retrySend, saveDraft/deleteDraft, markRead, deleteMessages, tagging, spam, classification rules) append events after their last state write and notify after the append.
A single hibernating MailEventHub Durable Object on the Worker and an in-process host on the Bun server, both driven by one runtime-neutral hub core; Node answers upgrades with 501.

Heartbeat, connection_init timeout, Origin check, per-IP/per-principal/global connection limits, max subscriptions, frame size limit and documented close codes; client reconnect with exponential backoff, jitter, cursor resume, resync and 4401 re-auth handling.
Web UI live-updates the list, unread counts, rail badges, recent addresses and drafts, shows Live/Reconnecting/Offline, and catches up on every LIVE.
CLI flying-mail watch [--domain] [--address] [--json] streams events with reconnect and per-endpoint/key-prefix/scope cursor persistence.
wrangler.toml declares the MAIL_EVENT_HUB binding and [[migrations]] tag v1-mail-event-hub with new_sqlite_classes; dry-run bundle succeeds; CSP gains only connect-src 'self'.
Design doc, README API section and flying-mail-deploy skill updated.
mise run lint, bun run test (all workspaces including apps/web) and mise run build-web pass; baseline 1830 package tests and 274 web tests still pass plus new tests.
nonGoals: No deploy, no remote wrangler (dry run only), no secrets, no DNS; the orchestrating session performs deployment and live verification.
No git commit, push, stash, reset or checkout by workers.
No replacement of the fetchStatus pull cursor; no subscriptions over HTTP SSE or multipart.
No events for fetch-state acknowledgements, tag catalogue changes, or domain/mailbox cascade deletes.
No WebSocket proxying in flying-mail client serve or on the Node runtime.
No graphql-ws or other new third-party dependency; no edits to migrations 0001-0015.
constraints: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md: English only, no emojis, maximum TypeScript strictness, Biome clean, ts-coding-standards, no TypeScript file at 1000+ lines; hub files under packages/infrastructure/src/realtime under 400 lines.
Keep existing Query/Mutation API, fetchStatus cursor, auth hardening (Turnstile, invite-only, rate limiting, bootstrap token) and CSP minimality intact.

Subscriptions create no new authentication path: sessions via a matching-Origin cookie, API keys via connection_init, both resolved through resolveViewerFromTokenHash; only token hashes stored; no secrets in URLs or logs.
The Bun server and the full test suite run without Cloudflare (in-process host).
Workers edit only their plan writePaths and their own plan Progress Log; impl-plans/PROGRESS.json and impl-plans/README.md are edited only by realtime-push-11; no worker edits this dispatch manifest.
Record sha256 before and after each edit; on drift re-read and reapply only the plan's intent; never revert others' edits; no repository-wide formatters.
Evidence for each plan and attempt goes under tmp/realtime-push-s306/<planId>/<attempt>/ (gitignored); plan 11 gate logs go to /tmp/realtime-push-final-<step>.log.
designDecisionsAndRationale: D1: D1 is the only event source and a notify is a payload-free poke, so replay and live share one code path and lost or reordered pokes cannot cause gaps.
D2: one drain loop with per-subscription lastSeq makes delivery gap-free and duplicate-free by construction (design 6.4).
D3/D4: global AUTOINCREMENT seq filtered per scope; cursor <epoch>.<seq> with the epoch seeded by the migration detects a database reset.
D5: the log stores ids, domain and addresses only; content is resolved at delivery through the normal read path (single authorization path).
D6: append after the state write as its own batch; an append failure is logged and does not fail the mutation.
D7: a single MailEventHub Durable Object (idFromName mail-events).
D8/D9: hand-written graphql-transport-ws server (state in DO storage, survives hibernation) and a zero-dependency shared client package @flying-mail/realtime-client.
D10: connection limits reuse RateLimiter and AUTH_RATE_LIMITER with ws: key prefixes.
D11: opportunistic pruning on append bounded by pruned_through_seq; no cron.
D12: CSP connect-src 'self' in both security-headers.ts and apps/web/public/_headers.
D13: cookie auth on sockets only with a matching Origin header (CSWSH protection).
D14: LIVE control event gives a resumable cursor without traffic and marks the catch-up point.

Plan review fixes: F-RP-A in-process scheduleWake timer with setWakeHandler late binding (plans 08, 10); F-RP-B explicit createBunFetchHandler branch with no ?? fallback (plan 10); F-RP-C HubRuntime injection for the 101 response and a single Worker notifier instance via buildWorkerConfig (plan 09).
Plan DAG: wave 1 (01, 02, 03) -> wave 2 (04a, 04b, 05, 06, 07) -> wave 3 (08) -> wave 4 (09, 10) -> wave 5 (11 serial reconciliation).
intentionalTradeoffs: R1: a single hub Durable Object; sharding is documented but not built.
R3: connection limits on the existing AUTH_RATE_LIMITER binding.
R4/D6: the event append is not atomic with the state write.
R5: no WebSocket through client serve or the Node runtime.
R6: hand-written client instead of the graphql-ws npm package.
R7: no events for fetch-state acknowledgements, tag catalogue changes or cascade deletes.
The DO migration tag v1-mail-event-hub is permanent once deployed.
F3: spurious RESYNC for long-idle scoped clients (low).
hub.admit counts per-IP and global connections from the hub state map rather than getWebSockets tags.
Concurrent sibling plans (04a/04b, 09/10) may see transient test or typecheck failures in each other's files; each re-runs after the sibling reports done; plan 11's full gates are authoritative.
supportedEdgeCases: Resume with after=cursor replays missed events in seq order then switches to LIVE without gaps or duplicates; client drops events whose cursor is older or the same.
Cursor older than retention or with a different epoch -> RESYNC_REQUIRED; web does a full refresh, API clients a fetchStatus sync.
Two subscriptions with identical query text and different variables stay independent (F1 regression).
Duplicate inbound delivery to a second managed address emits exactly one MESSAGE_RECEIVED; same address emits none; REJECTED ingest emits none.
deleteMessages mixed trash/purge emits UPDATED for trashed and DELETED for purged, with addresses captured before delete; deleteDraft captures addresses before delete.
Event append failure leaves the mutation result unchanged and skips notify.
4401 -> client stops and re-checks the session; 4403/4400/4409/4429/1009 -> fatal, no retry; other closes -> backoff with jitter capped at 30 s; LIVE resets backoff.
Cross-origin or malformed Origin -> 403; absent Origin ignores the cookie; limiter deny -> 429; missing subprotocol -> 400.
Unreadable or deleted message -> message null and addresses filtered to the viewer's readable subset.
Idle half-open sockets closed by the hub sweep (4000 idle, 4408 init timeout) driven by the DO alarm or the in-process timer.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Lost events from a failed append (accepted; clients converge on the next catch-up, API clients keep fetchStatus).
Scaling beyond one hub Durable Object.
WebSocket via flying-mail client serve or Node runtime (501).
Exact global rate-limit accuracy across Cloudflare locations.
Bun websocket idleTimeout value is confirmed by plan 10 against Bun docs; the hub sweep is authoritative.
The yoga HTTP/SSE subscription rejection code is recorded by plan 05's test.
residualRisks: D6 append not atomic with the state write (user-QA R4).
DO migration tag v1-mail-event-hub is permanent once deployed.
F3 spurious RESYNC for long-idle scoped clients (low).
